title: Cerberus — AI Cyber Defense Suite
description: Deception-first AI cyber defense platform built for NIRU Hackathon. Three-headed architecture: Decoy Engine (honeypot sessions), Credential Sentinel (ML risk scoring via keystroke biometrics), and BEC Assassin (NLP email threat detection). Full backend, ML model training (Isolation Forest, Random Forest, LinearSVC), database management, and cloud deployment on Render.

title: School Management System (Ruebens-man-sys)
description: A web-based system for school operations with MPESA payment integration. Features: user authentication, payment processing, database optimization.

title: Developers Mate
description: AI agent for developers, automating code generation, testing, and debugging for large projects. Includes NLP, bug detection, and scalable architecture.

title: e-Masomo Revamp
description: Renovated Moodle-based LMS for The Cooperative University of Kenya with Chipukizi Hive. Improved navigation, file handling, security and uptime. Led DevOps with AWS deployments, Docker, backups, and Behat testing.

title: Lux Shop
description: Responsive website for a friend's jewelry and art shop. Product showcase, contact form, and responsive design.
